name: caps.get
doc: What this computer has (input devices, sensors, Thunderbolt, modem, installed tools, the session kind), so Settings hides what GNOME Settings hides; event caps.changed.

name: gsettings.get
doc: Items for {keys: [{schema, key, path?}]}: value, default, writable, the allowlist mode and the key's type and range (notes/claude/settings-parity.md 6.1); event gsettings.changed.

name: gsettings.reset
doc: Reset {schema, path?, keys} of one schema to GNOME's defaults; allowlisted keys in a writing mode only.

name: gsettings.set
doc: Write {schema, path?, values} or {writes: [{schema, path?, values}]}: every key checked first (allowlist, type, range, lockdown, the extension's accelerators), then written in order and read back.
